lines.text: Many learners say: I don't have a time.
Any! I don't have any time.

native.hook: 「時間がない」に a は不要
native.tip: 「時間」の意味の time は数えられない名詞。a は付けません。
native.caption: “I don't have a time.”と言っていませんか？😅 「時間」という意味の time は数えられない名詞です。a は付けず、I don't have time と言います。 “I don't have time.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“any”。時間の time に a は不要。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.hook: Do you say “I don't have a time”?
en.tip: Time meaning free time has no a. Say I don't have time.
en.caption: Do you say “I don't have a time.”? 😅 Time as free time is uncountable, so no a. Say I don't have time. The natural way is “I don't have time.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
